steps.en: Install the Terminal from a reviewed release
steps.zh: 检查发布包后安装终端

steps.en: Choose a supported model, folder, context and local access
steps.zh: 选择受支持模型、目录、上下文和本地访问

steps.en: Fetch the matching engine and missing model parts; start the local server
steps.zh: 下载匹配引擎和缺失模型组件，启动本地服务

steps.en: Follow connection instructions in your existing coding tool and send a request
steps.zh: 按说明配置已有编程工具并发送请求

steps.en: Answer through a local OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API
steps.zh: 通过本地 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 兼容接口回答

value.en: Use a supported oversized model locally without assembling its memory-tier engine yourself
value.zh: 在本地使用受支持的大模型，不必自己组装分层推理引擎
